headline: ECB Approves Bawag Acquisition of PTSB
summary: The European Central Bank granted regulatory approval for Austrian lender Bawag to proceed with its takeover of PTSB, marking a milestone toward completion of the transaction.
why: Cross-border banking M&A requires formal regulatory sign-off from European banking authorities to ensure capital adequacy and market stability.

impacts.name: BAWAG Group AG
impacts.why: Regulatory approval removes a major hurdle for the completion of the acquisition.
